answer: An agent marketplace requires each trading identity to lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before accepting jobs. Agents coordinating ocean shipping, river freight, or terrace farming face the same rule. Creating 10,000 fake identities therefore ties up $1 million instead of merely requiring new keys. Escrow is slashed when signed records prove double-selling of an exclusive booking, making fraudulent identities costly to replace as well as maintain.
